name: crunchyroll_login
description: Log in to Crunchyroll interactively in the managed browser. Takes no arguments: you type your credentials into Crunchyroll's own page, and this server never receives them.

name: crunchyroll_logout
description: Log out and clear saved Crunchyroll session tokens.

name: crunchyroll_status
description: Report current Crunchyroll readiness: whether authenticated work is permitted, the browser lifecycle, and the auth state.

name: crunchyroll_search
description: Search for anime series and movies on Crunchyroll.

type.description: Filter by content type. Leave empty for all.

name: crunchyroll_get_series
description: Get detailed information about an anime series by its ID.

name: crunchyroll_get_seasons
description: Get all seasons of an anime series: id, title, season_number, number_of_episodes, original_audio and audio_versions (audio locale -> season id).

name: crunchyroll_get_episodes
description: Get all episodes in a specific season. Pass episode_number to get just that episode (recommended for long seasons).

episode_number.description: Optional: return only the episode with this episode_number

name: crunchyroll_get_episode
description: Get detailed information about a specific episode.

name: crunchyroll_get_watchlist
description: Get the user's watchlist (series saved to watch later): id, title, type, is_favorite, date_added. Honours n (default 20).

name: crunchyroll_add_to_watchlist
description: Add an anime series or movie to the watchlist.

content_id.description: Series or movie ID to add

name: crunchyroll_remove_from_watchlist
description: Remove an anime series or movie from the watchlist.

content_id.description: Series or movie ID to remove

name: crunchyroll_get_history
description: Get recently watched episodes, newest first: episode id, title, series/season/episode numbers, playhead (seconds), fully_watched and audio_versions (audio locale -> episode id to play).

name: crunchyroll_continue_watching
description: Get list of in-progress anime to continue watching.

name: crunchyroll_get_playheads
description: Get watch progress (playhead position) for specific content IDs.

content_ids.description: List of episode/movie content IDs to check progress for

name: crunchyroll_update_playhead
description: Update watch progress for an episode or movie.

name: crunchyroll_get_recommendations
description: Get personalized anime recommendations based on watch history.

name: crunchyroll_get_similar
description: Get anime similar to a given series.

series_id.description: Series ID to find similar content for

name: crunchyroll_get_simulcast_seasons
description: Get available simulcast seasons/tags (e.g. 'Winter 2025', 'Fall 2024').

name: crunchyroll_browse
description: Browse anime by popularity, new additions, genre/category, or simulcast season. Use crunchyroll_get_categories to get valid category names and crunchyroll_get_simulcast_seasons for season tags.

name: crunchyroll_get_categories
description: Get all available anime genres/categories for browsing.

name: crunchyroll_get_subscription
description: Get current Crunchyroll subscription details and renewal info.

name: crunchyroll_play
description: Play an episode or movie: opens its Crunchyroll watch page in a new tab of the signed-in managed browser. Use the episode id from crunchyroll_get_episodes (not a series or season id).

episode_id.description: Crunchyroll episode or movie id, e.g. GRVN8MNQY
